name: John Reif Memorial
where: Ithaca, NY · host Cornell · Moakley Course
headline: John Reif Memorial
summary: Final: Both 5K races were unscored. Syracuse freshmen took the top four men's places, led by Charles Guerrera in 14:50.3 and Andrew Walton in 14:51.1, with Cornell's Hunter Celkupa (15:40.7) the first non-Syracuse finisher. Syracuse sophomore Josie Baker won the women's race in 18:06.1, leading an Orange 1-2-3.
